review.verdict: First on Jeklik, Arlokk and Jin'do, top four on every boss
review.summary: The most damage on Jeklik, Arlokk and Jin'do, second on Venoxis, third on Mar'li, the Edge of Madness and Thekal, fourth on Mandokir and Hakkar. Average parse 88 against your usual 63. No deaths. Six Poison Cloud hits on Venoxis.

good.title: Consistency
good.text: Top four on all nine bosses.

review.verdict: Three interrupts, fourth on the Edge of Madness and Arlokk
review.summary: Three interrupts, the most: a Drain Life and two Heals. Fourth on the Edge of Madness (parse 94) and Arlokk. Venoxis (8th, 5 Poison Cloud hits) was the weak one.

review.verdict: First healer on Mar'li, Thekal and Arlokk
review.summary: First of the healers on Mar'li (44%), Thekal and Arlokk, second on four more. 9 Power Infusions and 6 Hexes dispelled.

review.verdict: 44 dispels and the Rebirth on Hakkar
review.summary: 44 dispels, the most: 29 Venom Spits, 4 Tranquilizing Poisons, 4 Poison Bolt Volleys. Rebirth on Fluffycatto on Hakkar. Healing was fourth of four on Jeklik, Venoxis, Mar'li, Mandokir and Hakkar.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Fourth of four on five bosses.

review.verdict: Parse 95 on Arlokk, seven Poison Cloud hits
review.summary: Parse 95 on Arlokk, 93 on the Edge of Madness, 91 on Thekal. Seven Poison Cloud hits on Venoxis, the most.

review.verdict: First on Venoxis, Mar'li and Hakkar
review.summary: The most damage on Venoxis, Mar'li and Hakkar, second on Arlokk and Jin'do, third on Mandokir. Average parse 87 against your usual 54. No deaths.

review.verdict: First on Mandokir, killed by Hakkar's melee
review.summary: First on Mandokir (parse 94), second on the Edge of Madness (99), top five on five more. Kicked Thekal's Great Heal. Hakkar's melee killed you at 0:31 and Dramima brought you back.

review.verdict: Curse of the Elements up, damage near the bottom
review.summary: 127 Curses of the Elements. Damage was 12th to 14th on every boss, average parse 19.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 14th of 15 on Venoxis, Mar'li and Jin'do.

review.verdict: Cleared Jin'do's Delusions, low damage
review.summary: The three Delusions on Jin'do were all yours. Damage was low: 13th on Jeklik, Venoxis, Mar'li, the Edge of Madness and Jin'do, average 30.

review.verdict: Tanked all nine, top damage on Jin'do
review.summary: Main tank on all nine bosses, parse 95 on the Edge of Madness and 92 on Jin'do, where your 36k tied for the most damage. Mind-controlled three times on Hakkar, Gaze twice on Mandokir, no deaths.

review.verdict: Parse 86 on Thekal, 62 average
review.summary: Parse 86 on Thekal and 82 on Arlokk, seventh on Jin'do. Average 62 against your usual 48. 47 Curses of Recklessness.

review.verdict: First healer on four bosses, 24 dispels
review.summary: First of the healers on Jeklik, Mandokir (41k), the Edge of Madness and Jin'do, where you dispelled the Hex. 24 dispels in all.

review.verdict: Parse 96 on Thekal, killed by Mandokir
review.summary: Third on Jeklik, fifth on Arlokk and Hakkar, parse 96 on Thekal. Mandokir's Mortal Strike killed you at 0:37 and a Chained Spirit revived you.

review.verdict: Killed by Guillotine on Mandokir
review.summary: Average parse 34, a bit over your usual 27, with 54 on Mar'li and 61 on the Edge of Madness. Guillotine killed you on Mandokir at 0:19 after you got the Gaze. Six Poison Cloud hits on Venoxis.

fix.title: Mandokir
fix.text: Guillotine at 0:19, right after the Gaze.

review.verdict: First healer on Venoxis and Hakkar
review.summary: First of the healers on Venoxis and Hakkar, second on Mar'li. Last of four on the Edge of Madness, Thekal, Arlokk and Jin'do. No dispels in the log.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last of four on four bosses.

review.verdict: Off-tank on four bosses
review.summary: Off-tanked Jeklik, Mandokir, Thekal and Hakkar, and kicked a Drain Life. Low damage on the rest (12th on Venoxis and the Edge of Madness).

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 12th on Venoxis and the Edge of Madness.

review.verdict: Almost no damage in the log
review.summary: 71/s on Jeklik, then the Holy Wrath chain killed you on Venoxis at 0:29, and after that the log has nothing from you on five bosses and next to nothing on the rest. If you were out of range or disconnected, ignore this.

good.title: Present
good.text: In the raid for all nine bosses.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: Zero on Mar'li, the Edge of Madness, Arlokk, Jin'do and Hakkar.

review.verdict: First on Thekal, second on Jeklik and Hakkar
review.summary: First on Thekal (parse 98), second on Jeklik and Hakkar (93), third on Venoxis. Average 84. Two Flamestrikes kicked.

review.verdict: Off-tanked Thekal, mid damage
review.summary: Sixth on Venoxis and Arlokk, parse 88 on the Edge of Madness, off-tank on Thekal. Six Poison Cloud hits on Venoxis.

review.verdict: Parse 99 on the Edge of Madness, top three on six bosses
review.summary: First on the Edge of Madness (parse 99), second on Mar'li, Mandokir and Thekal, third on Arlokk, Jin'do and Hakkar. Average parse 88, well over your usual 59. A Drain Life kick and a Mind Flay kick.
